sentences.en: The journalist was too upset to distinguish vice from virtue.
sentences.zh: 这位记者情绪太激动，分辨不清是非。

sentences.en: The political scandal was brought to light by two journalists.
sentences.zh: 两位记者揭露了政治丑闻。

sentences.en: The journalist took liberties with the facts he had gathered.
sentences.zh: 这名记者在整理事实时有些随意。
